method: All raster pixels touched by each 6m generated footprint cell; class 80 is permanent water, non-water classes remain unknown
limitations: WorldCover 2021 land cover is not a current water or flood map
10m resolution cannot rule out narrow watercourses and seasonal water
No DEM, protected area or land rights data
